data.logicContent:
SELECT
    o.${s_topic_field} as uid,
    o.${s_mdl_dte_field} as s_mdl_dte_field,
    o.uti_max_cc_his,
    o.uti_max_cc_6m,
    o.uid,
    o.rpt_tim,
    o.ratio_repay_cc_90d,
    o.ratio_repay_cc_720d,
    o.ratio_repay_cc_60d,
    o.ratio_repay_cc_360d,
    o.ratio_repay_cc_30d,
    o.ratio_repay_cc_180d,
    o.loan_nothousecar_price_min,
    o.loan_nothousecar_price_mean,
    o.loan_nothousecar_price_max,
    o.loan_nothousecar_over720d_price_min,
    o.loan_nothousecar_over720d_price_mean,
    o.loan_nothousecar_over720d_price_max,
    o.loan_nothousecar_720d_price_min,
    o.loan_nothousecar_720d_price_mean,
    o.loan_nothousecar_720d_price_max,
    o.loan_nothousecar_360d_price_min,
    o.loan_nothousecar_360d_price_mean,
    o.loan_nothousecar_360d_price_max,
    o.loan_nothousecar_180d_price_min,
    o.loan_nothousecar_180d_price_mean,
    o.loan_nothousecar_180d_price_max,
    o.loan_housecar_price_min,
    o.loan_housecar_price_mean,
    o.loan_housecar_price_max,
    o.loan_housecar_over720d_price_min,
    o.loan_housecar_over720d_price_mean,
    o.loan_housecar_over720d_price_max,
    o.loan_housecar_720d_price_min,
    o.loan_housecar_720d_price_mean,
    o.loan_housecar_720d_price_max,
    o.loan_housecar_360d_price_min,
    o.loan_housecar_360d_price_mean,
    o.loan_housecar_360d_price_max,
    o.loan_housecar_180d_price_min,
    o.loan_housecar_180d_price_mean,
    o.loan_housecar_180d_price_max,
    o.flag_defq_cc,
    o.ds,
    o.cnt_query_total_30d,
    o.amt_sum_repay_cc,
    o.amt_avg_repay_cc
FROM (
        SELECT
            s.${s_topic_field},
            s.${s_mdl_dte_field},
            f.uti_max_cc_his,
            f.uti_max_cc_6m,
            f.uid,
            f.rpt_tim,
            f.ratio_repay_cc_90d,
            f.ratio_repay_cc_720d,
            f.ratio_repay_cc_60d,
            f.ratio_repay_cc_360d,
            f.ratio_repay_cc_30d,
            f.ratio_repay_cc_180d,
            f.loan_nothousecar_price_min,
            f.loan_nothousecar_price_mean,
            f.loan_nothousecar_price_max,
            f.loan_nothousecar_over720d_price_min,
            f.loan_nothousecar_over720d_price_mean,
            f.loan_nothousecar_over720d_price_max,
            f.loan_nothousecar_720d_price_min,
            f.loan_nothousecar_720d_price_mean,
            f.loan_nothousecar_720d_price_max,
            f.loan_nothousecar_360d_price_min,
            f.loan_nothousecar_360d_price_mean,
            f.loan_nothousecar_360d_price_max,
            f.loan_nothousecar_180d_price_min,
            f.loan_nothousecar_180d_price_mean,
            f.loan_nothousecar_180d_price_max,
            f.loan_housecar_price_min,
            f.loan_housecar_price_mean,
            f.loan_housecar_price_max,
            f.loan_housecar_over720d_price_min,
            f.loan_housecar_over720d_price_mean,
            f.loan_housecar_over720d_price_max,
            f.loan_housecar_720d_price_min,
            f.loan_housecar_720d_price_mean,
            f.loan_housecar_720d_price_max,
            f.loan_housecar_360d_price_min,
            f.loan_housecar_360d_price_mean,
            f.loan_housecar_360d_price_max,
            f.loan_housecar_180d_price_min,
            f.loan_housecar_180d_price_mean,
            f.loan_housecar_180d_price_max,
            f.flag_defq_cc,
            f.ds,
            f.cnt_query_total_30d,
            f.amt_sum_repay_cc,
            f.amt_avg_repay_cc,
        dense_rank() over(partition by s.${s_topic_field} order by f.ds desc) as rn
        FROM  ${sample_table} s
        LEFT JOIN (
                    SELECT *
                    FROM
                        pdm_risk.pdm_risk_rh_bigtable_celue_v3
                    WHERE
                        datediff(to_date(ds ,'yyyyMMdd'), date_sub(to_date(${min_ds} ,'yyyyMMdd') ,${back_days})) >= 0
                    AND
                        ds <= ${max_ds}
                    ) f
        ON
            s.${s_topic_field}  = f.uid
        AND
        --- 数据回溯时，选择包含当天时，datediff 值大于等于0；否则仅大于0
            datediff(to_date(s.${s_mdl_dte_field}),to_date(f.ds ,'yyyyMMdd')) >= 0
        AND
            datediff(date_sub(to_date(s.${s_mdl_dte_field}),${back_days}),to_date(f.ds ,'yyyyMMdd')) <= 0
    ) o  WHERE rn = 1;
